response.sql:
WITH qc_counts AS (
  SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY arcref
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(qc_count) AS total_count, COUNT(*) AS num_projects
  FROM qc_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT
    qc_counts.arcref,
    qc_counts.qc_count,
    CAST(qc_counts.qc_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(totals.total_count AS FLOAT) AS share,
    CAST(qc_counts.qc_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(totals.total_count AS FLOAT) - 1.0 / CAST(totals.num_projects AS FLOAT) AS deviation
  FROM qc_counts
  CROSS JOIN totals
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST) AS dev_rank
  FROM with_shares
)
SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation
FROM ranked
WHERE dev_rank <= 10
ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST;

assumptions.assumption: QC data refers to the scanqc table; each row is one QC record associated with a project via arcref
The average share across projects equals 1 / (number of projects), derived from the fact that all shares sum to 1
Only projects with at least one QC record are included; projects in the projects table with no scanqc records do not appear
The database supports DENSE_RANK and NULLS LAST in ORDER BY (PostgreSQL or compatible)
